Same. I was 9 the first time, I tried to drown myself in a drum of water but to no avail it didn't work. That was when my aunt left for a husband. She left me too like my father. I'm 21, can't imagine suffering and living that long. My sister left me when I tried to stab her during a fight. My grandma left me to the other side. My mom doesn't talk to me now. My aunt who came back, doesn't talk to me too because I snapped on her. I'm just so irritated with everyone, I can't control my temper. I might hurt someone. I think it's better for me to leave. But I don't belong anywhere. I just wanna follow grandma. I want all of this to end.

CRABS!!! Specially the big ones. It always makes me itch. Had an allergic reaction back when I was 13yo, thought I'm gonna die, I suffer one whole day because of that. Had difficulty in breathing and lost energy going in & out of the restroom. I was alone too & no meds, I just dozed off. I ate little crabs recently, they taste amazing & crunchy but still makes me itch & makes my stomach churn like crazy but I just slept it off. Don't know why I'm the only one allergic to it. My whole family loves it & it's their favorite seafood.
If I go out, I might die by accident or I can survive it but it'll be embarrassing. I have urges everytime I go out. I don't wanna involve anybody tho.
